hypothesis: The chatbot can enforce Taiwan Traditional Chinese by default, answer English questions from the same approved Köhler evidence, refuse non-Köhler drugs, keep medical advice blocked, and select Taiwan public plant or materia-medica names before all other translations.
proof_of_done: Traditional Chinese, English and Simplified-input normalization cases pass.
Non-Köhler medicine questions are refused in both Traditional Chinese and English without external facts.
TaiCOL 皂質草 wins over the Tai2 alias 肥皂草, and Simplified Chinese remains the last fallback.
Traditional Chinese and English embedding questions both rank Köhler PDF page 192 first.
The active n8n acceptance workflows contain no machine-specific project path and remain inactive.
Only no-cost local or Free Tier services are used.

tools: Taiwan public-source registry built from official government and academic sources
Gemini API Free Tier gemini-embedding-2 for one new English query

promotion_scope: Promote only the chat language, scope, Taiwan-name priority and bilingual two-page retrieval gates. This does not claim that a public chat API or full-book index is complete.
